title: the bus_client measure_only guard plants its own breach
intention: The bus_client measure-only proof is not blind because of a breach it plants itself, not because the live tree happens to hold one. A clean tree passes; a sieve that sees nothing still reds.
why: Measured 2026-11-12: cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_bus_client_proofs_measure_only_bus_client.py reds at test_no_bus_client_file_reaches_a_device with "0 breach(es) in all; these: ". inspector.encapsulation_breaches('.') over the live tree returned 0, so the not-blind guard 'not mine and bool(breaches)' reds on a clean tree, and B's (99258e9bbdb1) validate criterion 2 cannot pass.
traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation; a clean tree is its aim) and Law 8 (a proof a hollow build could not pass: the blindness check stays, in a stronger form).
how: A new tooth runs the sieve over a scratch tree with one planted bus_client file importing cairn.devices.codemother and checks for exactly that row. The live tooth drops its need for breaches elsewhere. This mirrors the never-beats proof's fixture walk.
